research_question: RQ21: does an artifact-validity instrument, scored separately from a learning-outcome instrument, predict whether a production earns real fusion weight?

claims.text: An independent district's own artifact-validity instrument, scored apart from any learning-outcome measure, corroborated the same reading an earlier district's own production reported.

evidence.quote: An independent district's own artifact-validity instrument, scored apart from any learning-outcome measure, corroborated the same reading an earlier district's own production reported.
